title: "Waste Discarded"
next_chapter_hook: "Just as he was about to give up, the turtle shell that had never shown any reaction suddenly grew warm, as if something long dormant was slowly awakening..."

text.content:
"Tianqing Sect, Martial Arena.

The morning mist had yet to disperse, the dew on the blue stone slabs reflecting the rising sun, sharp and biting. A gaunt figure was bending over, wiping the ground, his movements mechanical and熟练, as if he had repeated them thousands of times.

Chen Ji lifted his sleeve to wipe the sweat from his forehead, his gaze calmly sweeping across the distant Inner Sect Tower. Those buildings with carved beams and painted rafters, shrouded in immortal aura, were places he could never enter in this lifetime.

Outer Disciple/Servant—this was his entire identity in this sect."

"Three years ago, he could still make a name for himself as a 'genius' within the sect. At twelve, he broke through to Qi Refining Third Layer, and an elder declared he would 'surely achieve greatness in the future.' However, after his father's disappearance, everything changed.

His spiritual root withered, his cultivation stalled. The former prodigy plummeted into a废物 others could bully. His cultivation resources were stripped away, his techniques recalled, even his living quarters were demoted from Inner Disciple quarters to a woodshed in the corner of the Martial Arena.

'Three years.' Chen Ji muttered to himself, a self-mocking curve forming at the corner of his mouth. 'A废物 should have a废物的觉悟.'"

dialogue.content:
"'Oh, isn't this our 'Great Genius Chen'? A brazen voice broke the morning silence.

Chen Ji's movements paused as he slowly straightened up.

The newcomer was Han Lie, the number one genius of Xuanwu Sect. At just fifteen years old, he had already broken through to Qi Refining Seventh Layer. Now he stood with hands clasped behind his back, followed by seven or eight Outer Disciples, each strutted with arrogance.

Han Lie looked down at Chen Ji, his contempt undisguised: 'Three years stuck at Qi Refining Second Layer—I'd say the word '废物' insults this term. Why not change it to 'parasite' instead? A parasite that exclusively eats the sect's grain.'"

"Chen Ji watched him silently, saying nothing.

That gaze, so平静 it approached emptiness, made Han Lie inexplicably irritable. In his imagination, this废物 should either kowtow and beg for mercy, or flare up in retort—either way, it would give him proper justification to 'teach him a lesson.'

But this fellow simply wore the expression of a dead pig unafraid of boiling water, as if Han Lie didn't exist at all.

'What? Cat got your tongue?' Han Lie stepped forward, kicking over the water bucket beside Chen Ji, dirty water splashing all over him. 'I'm talking to you,废物!'"

choice.prompt: "Faced with Han Lie's public humiliation, what will you do?"

choices.description: "Bow and apologize, admitting you are a废物, avoiding direct conflict"

dialogue.content:
"Yes, Han Shixiong is right.' Chen Ji lowered his head, his voice平静 without a trace of波动. 'I'm a废物.

He bent down to pick up the water bucket, as if nothing had happened, continuing to wipe the floor.

Han Lie愣了一下, then burst out laughing: 'Hahaha! Did you hear that? The废物 admitted it himself!' The小弟 behind him joined in the laughter.

But deep in Chen Ji's eyes, a cold light flashed—he记下了."

"Laugh, laugh.' Han Lie laughed until he rocked back and forth, yet failed to notice that Chen Ji's knuckles gripping the mop had turned white.

'Someday...' Chen Ji silently said in his heart, 'Today's humiliation, a hundred times returned.'"

choices.description: "Use a平淡 tone to say something that puts the other party in an untenable position"

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji slowly straightened up, wiping the dirty water from his face with his sleeve.

He didn't look at Han Lie, but rather at the surrounding disciples, his voice not loud yet clearly entering each person's ears: 'Three years, and the number one genius of Xuanwu Sect comes here daily, just to bully a废物?'

He paused, a slight smile forming: 'Han Shixiong, your time... truly is worthless.'"

text.content:
"The surrounding disciples instantly fell silent, then erupted into suppressed snickering.

Han Lie's face turned livid, his fists clenched tight, veins bulging. 'What did you say?!' He stepped forward sharply, the pressure of Qi Refining Seventh Layer pouring out.

Chen Ji had already lowered his head again, continuing to wipe the floor, as if those words hadn't come from him at all."

choices.visible_cost: "The other party may go even further"

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji said nothing.

He merely picked up the water bucket and continued his work, as if Han Lie was nothing but a gust of noisy wind.

This silence was more devastating than any words. Han Lie felt like he'd punched into cotton, suffocatingly frustrated."

"废物就是废物，连反驳的胆子都没有！' Han Lie flew into a rage, kicking away the mop in Chen Ji's hand. '给我记住，今天的羞辱只是开始！

With that, he coldly snorted and turned to leave.

Chen Ji gazed at his retreating back, his pupils deep and幽深—棋局已布，静待落子.',"

text.content:
"日上三竿，演武场渐渐热闘起来。

内门弟子们陆续出现，三三两两地在广场上修炼切磋。偶尔有人投来目光，却无一人为陈机说话。在他们眼中，一个连灵根都枯竭的废物，根本不值得浪费注意力。

"陈机！"一个管事模样的中年男子走了过来，扔给他一块令牌，"今日的杂役结束了。明日轮到藏经阁打扫，卯时之前到。"

陈机接过令牌，恭敬地行了一礼："是。""

"管事瞥了他一眼，眼中闪过一丝怜悯，却很快被淡漠取代。

"别怨天尤人，"他压低声音说了一句，便转身离去。

陈机望着他的背影，唇角微微上扬。这位管事是少数几个对他没有恶意的人，虽然也从未帮过他。

"至少……还有人愿意说这么一句。"他低声喃喃，将令牌收入怀中。

怀中，一枚温润的龟甲贴着他的胸口，隐隐传来一丝不易察觉的温度。"

choice.prompt: "After completing servant duties, what do you plan to do?"

choices.text: "Go to the dining hall for a meal"
choices.description: "Though only able to eat leftovers, the body is the capital of revolution"

text.content:
"Chen Ji dragged his exhausted body toward the dining hall.

Along the way, disciples cast various gazes his way—some mocking, some pitying, most indifferent. Chen Ji accepted them all, his expression unchanged.

Inside the dining hall, Outer Disciples and Servant Disciples crowded in a corner, their food thin soup and weak vegetables, barely filling the stomach. On the other side, Inner Disciples' area was fragrant with wine and meat, exotic delicacies.

Chen Ji scooped a bowl of thin porridge, found a corner, and ate silently."

choices.description: "Conserve energy, cultivate the turtle shell method left by his father"
choices.risk_hint: "The turtle shell's secret may be discovered"

text.content:
"Chen Ji did not go to the dining hall but went straight back to the woodshed.

That small room in the corner of the Martial Arena was merely a few feet wide, the dilapidated wooden bed covered with thin bedding. The only valuable item in the room was the turtle shell left by his father.

Chen Ji sat cross-legged on the bed, took the turtle shell from his chest, and placed it in his palm. The pale yellow turtle shell was simple and plain, its patterns already blurred and indistinct, showing nothing special.

But he knew—within this turtle shell lay the truth of his father's disappearance."

choices.description: "Go ahead and survey the Scripture Library environment, look for possible opportunities"
choices.risk_hint: "Outer Disciples have no right to enter"

text.content:
"Chen Ji calculated briefly in his mind and decided to scout the Scripture Library in advance.

As an Outer Servant, he had a few opportunities each month to sweep the outer areas of the Scripture Library. But the interior was off-limits to Outer Disciples.

However, opportunities often hide within the cracks of rules.

He deliberately took a few detours, avoided the crowd, and came to the quiet area behind the Scripture Library. From a distance, the three-story pavilion was grand and imposing, yet protected by three layers of formations.

Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, silently memorizing all this, then slipped away."

"Night fell, and Tianqing Sect fell into silence.

In the woodshed, Chen Ji lit an oil lamp the size of a bean, its dim yellow light barely illuminating a small space. He sat on the bed, the turtle shell in his hand, his gaze complex.

Three years.

For three years, he endured daily humiliation, did the dirtiest and hardest work, ate the worst food, lived in a place worse than even a woodshed. Everyone waited to see him completely decline, waiting for him to become a true废物.

'Father...' Chen Ji murmured softly, his fingertips gently stroking the patterns on the turtle shell. 'When will the person you mentioned appear?'"

"The turtle shell lay quietly in his palm, showing no response.

Chen Ji苦笑. Before his father's disappearance, he left this turtle shell, saying when 'the time comes,' he would naturally understand everything. But three years passed, and the turtle shell remained a dead object, without a trace of divinity.

Perhaps his father's prophecy was merely wishful thinking. Perhaps he truly had become a废物, with no chance of翻身.

Just as his thoughts wandered—

The turtle shell suddenly grew slightly warm.

Chen Ji shuddered all over, looking down. The turtle shell's surface revealed a faint glow, and those originally blurred patterns actually faintly outlined a certain pattern.

'This is...' His pupils contracted sharply."

dialogue.content:
"'Three years, and you finally call to me at night.'

An elderly and ethereal voice rang in Chen Ji's mind.

Chen Ji猛然抬头, only to see above the turtle shell, a虚幻 figure slowly condensing. It was a white-haired elder, his features blurred, yet with deep eyes like an abyss.

'Who are you...' Chen Ji suppressed the shock in his heart.

'I am Mo Xiansheng,' the elder微微一笑, 'by your father's orders, waiting here.'"

choice.prompt: "Facing the suddenly appearing Mo Xiansheng, will you?"

choices.description: "Immediately inquire about father's news—this is what you most want to know"

dialogue.content:
"'My father!' Chen Ji blurted almost reflexively. 'Where is he now? Why did he leave back then? Is he okay?'

A stream of questions poured out, the emotions compressed for three years bursting forth at this moment.

Mo Xiansheng沉默片刻, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes: 'Your father... he went to a very far place. There are great dangers there, but also heavenly opportunities.'"

"The elder sighed: 'He went to protect you, and also to seek a method to counter 'that thing.''

'That thing?' Chen Ji frowned.

'Now is not the time to speak of it,' Mo Xiansheng shook his head. 'You only need to know—your father is still alive. But to find him, you must grow stronger.'"

choices.description: "First clarify the turtle shell's origin and function"
choices.risk_hint: "May not be able to bear the truth"

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji深吸一口气, forcing himself to冷静下来.

'This turtle shell, exactly what is it?' He raised the turtle shell in his hand. 'Father left it saying 'when the time comes, you'll naturally understand,' but three years passed, and it never showed any reaction.'

Mo Xiansheng微微一笑: 'The turtle shell is the vessel, and you—' He paused, his gaze profound. 'Are that 'timing.''"

"'The spiritual root in your body has not withered,' Mo Xiansheng slowly said. 'It has been sealed by a powerful force. This seal originates from the 'Heavenly Secrets' bloodline you carry in your blood.'

He raised his finger and gently tapped the turtle shell.

In that instant, Chen Ji felt his mind explode like thunder, countless pieces of information flooding in like a tide—

Tianji Record.
Foresee three hours into the future.
Each use consumes 5 points of Heavenly Fate."

choices.description: "Stay vigilant, first confirm whether the other party is an enemy in disguise"

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji did not immediately believe.

Three years of treacherous hearts had cultivated his instinctive vigilance. He stepped back, his voice deep: 'Why should I believe you?'

Mo Xiansheng slightly startled, then laughed: 'Good, good! Caution is good. If you easily believed others, your father would反而 disappointed.'"

"The elder raised his hand, and a段画面 emerged in empty air—it was three years ago, a man handing a turtle shell to young Chen Ji, softly saying: 'A-Ji, Father has to go on a long journey. This turtle shell, you must keep it safe. The day it grows warm will mean the time has come.'

Chen Ji shuddered all over. That voice, that back—正是 his father Chen Xuan!

'Now, do you believe?' Mo Xiansheng asked."

"Mo Xiansheng's form began to fade, clearly maintaining this形态 consumed him great power.

'Tonight you have contacted the introductory method of the Tianji Record,' he郑重地看着 Chen Ji. 'But this is merely the beginning. The Tianji Record is incomplete; to complete it, you need to achieve a series of goals. And with each goal completed, this old one will unseal a page of knowledge.'

Chen Ji nodded, recording every word faithfully in his heart."

"'The first scroll's goal is only one,' Mo Xiansheng's voice grew more ethereal. 'Survive the Sect Tournament.'

'Sect Tournament?' Chen Ji frowned.

'That's right. In three months, Tianqing Sect will hold its triennial Sect Tournament.' A profound light flashed in Mo Xiansheng's eyes. '届时，所有外门弟子都要参加。而你——'

He didn't finish, but the meaning was clear enough.

With Chen Ji's current 'Qi Refining Second Layer' strength, in the Sect Tournament he would either be eliminated, or... die."

text.content:
"Mo Xiansheng's form completely dissolved, leaving only one sentence echoing in the woodshed:

'Remember, the power of the Tianji Record is not infinite. Heavenly Fate is the foundation of your survival in this world; once exhausted, you will...'

The voice cut off abruptly.

Chen Ji looked down at the turtle shell in his hand. After the extraordinary phenomenon just now, the turtle shell had returned to平静, but he could feel—the connection between them was deeper now.

In his mind, a残缺画面 faintly emerged—that was the雏形 of some cultivation method.

'Tianji Record...' Chen Ji murmured, his eyes flashing with complex light.

Three years of忍, three years of布局, today finally saw the dawn."

"Outside the window, night wind howled, causing the dilapidated wooden window to creak.

Chen Ji lay on the bed, yet sleep was nowhere to be found. His mind kept replaying tonight's information—Tianji Record, father, Heavenly Fate, Sect Tournament...

Three months.

He only had three months.

'Han Lie, Ling Yuan, and those enemies hiding in the dark...' Chen Ji closed his eyes, a cold smile curling at his lips. 'Since you all want to see me die, let me show you what truly means—扮猪吃虎.'

Outside the woodshed, moonlight like water.

And just as Chen Ji was about to fall asleep, the turtle shell grew warm again, as if responding to something."
"Just as he was about to give up, the turtle shell that had never shown any reaction suddenly grew warm, as if something long dormant was slowly awakening..."
